## 1.1.2

- RootHide package now ACTUALLY supports arm64 devices (oops)

## Install

A userspace reboot is required after installing or updating.

## Release files

- `com.nicksworks.roadrunnerreborn_1.1.2_iphoneos-arm64.deb` — rootless (arm64 + arm64e)
- `com.nicksworks.roadrunnerreborn_1.1.2_iphoneos-arm64e.deb` — RootHide (arm64 + arm64e)
- `SHA256SUMS` — checksums for both packages
